title: json-fn deployment validation test suite
description: Documents the portable deployment validation test-suite format consumed from spec/cases/deployment.

description.description: A description of the test suite.

cases.description: The validation cases in this suite.

name.description: A name used as the test name.

validator.description: The validation operation exercised by this case.

value.description: The direct input for schema, contract, and profile validation.

contract.description: An environment contract used as context for profile, link, or deployment validation.

module.description: A canonical json-fn module used for link or deployment validation.

profile.description: A deployment profile used for prepared-deployment validation.

adapterFunctions.description: Names of host functions supplied by the mock runtime adapter.

adapterEffects.description: Names of effects supplied by the mock runtime adapter.

expected.description: Whether validation should succeed, or the diagnostic expected on failure.
